metadata.description: AI coding skill for gohud, the HUD & UI kit for Godot 4.6+. Build menus, HUDs, dialogs, sheets, forms and themes with gohud, preview its demo scenes, and list its features.

plugins.name: gohud
plugins.description: Build Godot 4.6+ game UI with gohud: menus, HUD bars, quick slots, joystick, dialogs, bottom sheets, forms, notices, coach marks, presets (default, sci-fi, medieval), JSON themes, skins and icon sets. Includes /gohud:preview to launch the gallery or demo and /gohud:features to explain every feature.
